newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JCI may build Africa iron ore plant - report.
newsitem.headline: JCI may build Africa iron ore plant - report.

text.p: South Africa's JCI Ltd is considering building a two billion rand iron ore plant in Africa with international partners, Business Tonight reported.
The project could be undertaken in Zaire, Namibia or Gabon, the business television programme said. It gave no details.

JCI Managing Director Bill Nairn told a presentation of the mining house's results for the year to June 30 on Tuesday that new expansion projects approved in 1996 had an aggregate capital cost of 1.9 billion rand.
These included extensive capital development at all of the group's gold mines to raise available ore reserves and exploiting the five-seam project at the Tavistock coal mine.
